public_repository_policy: No confidential raw rows, credentials, station identifiers, exact coordinates, calendar timestamps, or security-sensitive topology
permitted_public_artifacts: frozen scoring code and model commit
synthetic traces with the same schema

reviewer_access.preferred: institution-approved controlled inspection or secure transfer to the editor/reviewers
reviewer_access.fallback: publish approved aggregates and synthetic traces while narrowing claims if raw inspection cannot be arranged
reviewer_access.nda_or_data_use_agreement: required when imposed by the custodian

claim_boundary: Confidential raw data may support external validation only when provenance, independent cases, pre-outcome freezing, fixed scoring, and reviewer verification are documented; confidentiality alone is not validation.
